comments.author: Donce
comments.body:
You can enter El Dorado by doing quest called "Legendary Land of Gold".
You can get this quest by doing Treasure hunt Rank 10 Theme Treasure Legends.

Rank 12 Search, rank 14 Appraisal, rank 10 Recognition required.

comments.author: Hernan
comments.body: one of the most beautiful areas ingame

comments.author: CrissaEs
comments.body: Yes, that's right. You can enter El Dorado by doing TH "Treasure Legends", but you can't discover that city... In effect, you can't come back here anytime.
